detail.title: Walk-through Metal Detector for Prohibited Items Classification Detection
detail.overview: Favourite ISC-D816S Walk-through Metal Detector for Prohibited Items Classification Detection Key Points ●It Features Strong Anti-Interference Capabilities, High Precision, And Stable Performance ●The Detector Supports Multiple Detection Modes ●The Operating Interface Utilizes A 10-Inch Color Touchscreen Display ●The Main Unit Is Equipped With A 29-Inch Full HD Color LCD Display On The Rear ●The Equipment Supports Network Connectivity, Meeting The Needs Of Smart Security Screening Solutions Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Metal Detection.Working Mode: 4 detection modes are selectable: metal detection, mobile phone detection, prohibited item detection, and classification detection.
Metal Detection.People Counting: Supports selectable counting modes (front + rear +, front + rear - and separate counting).

Live View.People Counting Display: Displays the pass number, metal alarm number, human figure, detected object type icons and text on 29-inch LCD screen and 10-inch touch screen; if equipped with smart camera, video images, personnel detection and comparison pictures, historical data can be displayed on 29-inch large screen.

Personnel Detection.Personnel Detection: 1.12 persons/second (1,080P) for one channel, 12 persons/second (1,080P) for two channels. 2. Supports identification without mask.
Personnel Detection.Intelligent Playback (Personnel Detectio: 1. Query conditions: By pass channel, time and personnel attribute. 2. Function: Supports search results associated playback of 10 seconds of video before and after the event, and search results export as excel, video and picture. 3.Historical library capacity: 10 million

Personnel Comparison.Database Management: 1. Import method: import personnel images single/in batches through the browser, single card modeling speed 10 pictures/second 2. Personnel information: name, gender, birthday, province, city, ID type and ID number; custom 3.Database capacity: create up to 10 personnel databases, 300,000 pictures, total capacity 50G 4.Image requirements: jpg format, max size of a single image is 4M, pixel range 100×100–6,000×5,000.
Personnel Comparison.Personnel Comparison: 1.Comparison mode: rear FD+rear FR 2.AI by camera: supports 4-channel image stream 3.AI by device function configuration: normal/stranger mode; supports multiple personnel databases, support alarm prompts, linkage recording, snapshot, IPC external alarm output, voice prompts, buzzer, log records, emails performance: AI by device supports 1-channel personnel comparison (1,080p video stream)

Video and Audio.Video Output: 3-Channel HDMI output resolution supports 1,920 × 1,080 /1,280 × 1,024/1,280 × 720/1,024 × 768, 1,280 × 1,024 by default.
Video and Audio.Third-party Camera Access: onvif, RTSP, Panasonic, Sony, Axis, Arecont, Pelco, Canon, Samsung and GB/T28181

Recording Management.Recording Method: Auto recording; manual recording; alarm recording; scheduled recording
Recording Management.Playback Method: Instant playback; conventional playback; event playback; label playback; Intelligent playback (personnel, dynamic detection)

Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Video, snapshot, IPC external alarm output, voice prompt, buzzer, log record, preset point and mail.

Port.Power port: *2, on the side of the detector panel.

Regular.Gross Weight: Detector panel: 100 kg (220.46 lb) Case: 32.6 kg (71.99 lb)
